primitives.meaning: a verification attempt that did not establish its claim
entryFilters: a verification attempt that did not establish its claim
no instance of this journey is already open for the the verification instance that failed
hard gates (GLB-31) allow communication for this purpose

primitives.does: Classify the failure as INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, MISMATCH, UNREADABLE, EXPIRED_EVIDENCE, TECHNICAL_FAILURE, POLICY_FAILURE, REVIEW_REQUIRED or UNKNOWN. The class decides the route, and it decides something else: recording our own outage as an identity rejection marks someone as having failed a check they never got to attempt

primitives.asks: What kind of failure was it?

branches.label: The person can correct it
branches.test: insufficient evidence, unreadable evidence, or evidence that has expired

branches.label: Ours, and transient
branches.test: a technical failure on our side or a provider's

branches.label: Needs a person
branches.test: a mismatch, an explicit review requirement, or a failure nobody could classify

branches.label: Terminal by policy
branches.test: policy forbids verifying this claim on this basis at all

primitives.asks: Does the retry budget for this claim have room?

branches.label: Room to retry
branches.test: attempts against this claim are within the policy limit for its security sensitivity

branches.label: Budget spent
branches.test: the limit is reached - and repeated failure is also what a genuine person struggling looks like

orderedRoles.eligibleWhen: the person is active in the product and the action is taken there
the message has to be kept and survive until the person can act on it

primitives.purpose: Explain exactly what needs correcting and offer the bounded retry.
primitives.brief: Explain exactly what needs correcting and offer the bounded retry. A retry offered without an explanation produces the same attempt again, which spends the budget without improving anything
primitives.label: CANONICAL_RULE

primitives.asks: Is a safe retry available within the backoff budget?

branches.label: Retry
branches.test: the failure is transient and the budget has room

branches.label: Persistent
branches.test: the technical failure is not clearing

primitives.does: Retry with backoff, recording nothing against the person's verification history. Our failure is not their rejection, and the distinction has to survive into whatever reads that history later

orderedRoles.eligibleWhen: the person is active in the product and the action is taken there
the message has to be kept and survive until the person can act on it

primitives.purpose: Say that this claim cannot be verified on this basis, and name what basis would be accepted if any is.
primitives.brief: Say that this claim cannot be verified on this basis, and name what basis would be accepted if any is. Somebody who attempted verification and hears nothing will attempt it again, and each attempt writes a failure against a person who was never going to be able to pass
primitives.label: CANONICAL_RULE

primitives.state: bounded retry available; the verification instance stays open
primitives.reEntry: the retry runs as part of the same verification instance, against the same budget - a new instance would reset the count, which is how a bounded retry becomes an unbounded one

primitives.on: a technical failure that is not clearing
carries: the failure class and how often it has recurred
the people currently unable to verify because of it, which is what makes this operational rather than administrative

primitives.on: a failure requiring human judgement, or a budget reached
carries: the failure class and every attempt made
the claim being verified, so the reviewer assesses the claim rather than the attempts

primitives.state: verification not possible on this basis
